core_obligations: Show that in the situation of example-family-associated-module (tag 0H4Q), if S is locally Noetherian and F is flat over S in dimensions at least r (flat-definition-flat-dimension-n, tag 0CWG), then [F/X/S]_r is a relative r-cycle on X/S (proof lines 1123-1144). First, flat-lemma-pre-flat-dimension-n (tag 0CWF) preserves the flatness hypothesis under any base change, and lemma-family-associated-module (tag 0H4R) makes the formation of [F/X/S]_r compatible with any base change; since compatibility with specializations is tested after base change to the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring, reduce to S a valuation ring (proof lines 1124-1130). Second, on the valuation ring base the flat locus U = {x in X : F flat at x over S} is open by flat-lemma-finite-type-flat (tag 05IQ); the complement has fibres of dimension below r by hypothesis, so restriction along U included in X induces isomorphisms on the groups of r-cycles on fibres after any base change, compatible with the specialization maps and with the formation of the cycle class of F, reducing the specialization check to [F|_U/U/S]_r (proof lines 1131-1141). Third, F|_U is flat over S, so lemma-specialization-module (tag 0H4I) gives compatibility with specializations directly (proof lines 1142-1143).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a valuation ring base using base-change stability of the flatness hypothesis and of the cycle-class construction (proof lines 1124-1130).
Shrink to the open flat locus, whose complement has low-dimensional fibres so restriction is an isomorphism on r-cycle groups compatible with specializations (proof lines 1131-1141).
Conclude on the flat locus from the valuation-ring specialization lemma for flat coherent sheaves (proof lines 1142-1143).
